rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key (one-to-one with Cust_Bio_dirty) and identifier; null values would break referential integrity

rule: S_N must be between 1 and 30 inclusive
rationale: Serial number domain constraint based on observed sequential range; values outside this range indicate data corruption or overflow

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N functions as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty; duplicates (e.g., value '3' appearing twice) indicate data quality issues

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for subscription accounts

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 4 digits (derived from the data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.

rule: Account_No must be unique across all records
rationale: Account numbers should uniquely identify accounts; duplicates (e.g., '1001', '1010') require clarification per evidence

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is mandatory customer identification data

rule: Full_Name words (except cultural particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o) must start with uppercase letter
rationale: Evidence shows lowercase entries ('irfan', 'junrong') and mixed case ('Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan') that require standardization to Title Case

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence shows double spaces in 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' requiring whitespace normalization

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory unique identifier (NRIC/FIN)

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, G), 7 digits, one checksum letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow format aXXXXXXXa; 3.3% are malformed (e.g., 'S123456' with only 6 digits)

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: JoinDate has 3.3% missing values observed in sample; required for temporal analysis

rule: JoinDate must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Evidence shows unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13) and mixed formats requiring validation

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate represents historical account creation; future date '2027-01-15' indicates data entry error

rule: LastLogin must not be null
rationale: LastLogin is mandatory activity tracking field with 0% missing in evidence

rule: LastLogin must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Field is stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; must validate format before conversion

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Logical temporal constraint: account creation must precede or equal last login activity

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Mandatory categorical field for subscription tier classification

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Domain constraint based on observed valid subscription tiers

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: Field has 6.7% missing values observed; required for financial analysis

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Evidence shows non-numeric value 'free' mixed with numeric strings; requires standardization

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value 99999
rationale: Value '99999' appears as statistical outlier and sentinel code for missing/invalid data

rule: SubscriptionFee must be between 0 and 2000 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for subscription fees; valid fees observed between 16.53 and 961.14, with 0 as valid for free tiers

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, null, or 'free'
rationale: Business logic: Free tier subscriptions should not have a positive fee; flags inconsistencies like Free with $917.46

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') not in [0, None] and str(row['SubscriptionFee']).lower() != 'free'

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Mandatory boolean status indicator with 0% missing values

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Field contains inconsistent boolean representations that require standardization; restricts to observed valid values before conversion

rule: AccountBalance must not be null
rationale: Mandatory financial field with 0% missing values

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0
rationale: Value 99999.0 appears as statistical outlier and sentinel code for missing/invalid balance data

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative
rationale: Evidence shows sign-anomalous negative value (-150.5) in an almost-entirely-positive column; requires verification if valid overdraft or error

rule: PreferredLanguage must not be null
rationale: Mandatory language preference field with 0% missing values

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
rationale: Domain constraint based on observed valid language options

rule: Device must not be null
rationale: Mandatory device classification field with 0% missing values

rule: Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
rationale: Domain constraint based on observed valid device types

rule: OS must not be null
rationale: Mandatory operating system field with 0% missing values

rule: OS must be one of the canonical forms: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
rationale: Standardizes observed variants (android, IOS, LINUX, macOs) to official brand casing

rule: FeedbackScore must not be null
rationale: Mandatory feedback metric with 0% missing values

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint based on FeedbackScore1 range and business logic; flags sentinel value 7.3 as out of range

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel value 7.3
rationale: Value 7.3 is statistical outlier exceeding expected range and appears sentinel-coded

rule: FeedbackScore1 must not be null
rationale: Mandatory feedback metric with 0% missing values

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint based on observed valid range 1.0-5.0

rule: FeedbackScore must equal FeedbackScore1 (near-duplicate column check)
rationale: Evidence indicates 81.25% value resemblance suggesting duplication; flags divergent values (e.g., 7.3 vs 2.65) for consolidation review

rule: S_N must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N (one-to-one referential integrity)
rationale: S_N is designated as one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty; every value must have corresponding match in sibling table

rule: Full_Name must match Cust_Bio_dirty.Name after case and whitespace normalization (via S_N join)
rationale: One-to-one key implies consistent identity data across tables; validates name synchronization between account and bio tables

check_params.semantic_check: Verify that Full_Name matches Name after normalizing case and whitespace (e.g., 'Wang Shi Jie' vs 'WANG SHI JIE')

rule: ID must exactly match Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No for the same S_N
rationale: One-to-one key implies consistent identity data; validates ID synchronization between tables

check_params.semantic_check: Verify that ID matches ID_No exactly for corresponding S_N records

rule: Malay/Indian name particles (Bin/s/o indicating Male, Binte/d/o indicating Female) must match Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Cultural naming conventions encode gender information; validates consistency between name particles and demographic Gender field

check_params.semantic_check: Verify that Malay/Indian name particles are consistent with Gender: presence of Bin or s/o implies Male; presence of Binte or d/o implies Female
